body:
The checkpointed installed controller is running for two official-listed AnnData PRs, #2710 and #2641: a stable-branch backport and the original fix. These are related integration inputs, not two semantically independent tasks. [Frozen inputs](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/commit/c07470ee), [installed candidate #52](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/52). No native acceptance or fresh unique task is established yet.

The unchanged official pr_runtime pipeline uses pinned source/ref, inclusive 2026-10-19 / limit 50 discovery, Sonnet 4.6/OpenRouter, 20 turns / 1800 seconds, temperature 0.2 / 2048 output, $5 estimated/actual stop plus conservative final-request reservation. No fallback, extra model calls, task/environment/parser/grading repair, APT prefix or verifier timeout change. Both candidates and their original filtering decisions are retained. BSD 3-Clause license bytes match across both base/head refs; full notices are frozen.

Same epic 32 CPUh/$90 operating ceiling, strictly below $100 extra; existing reserved TRC CPUs only. At controller launch, actual 9.596001 CPUh/$0.287646 (11 prior calls), generation CPU reservation 6.333333 h, model reservation $13.07 and existing archival reservation $10. These reservations are not spend. No new allowance, capacity or accelerators. Ledger/billing holds prevent later admission.

Generation, exports, original independent control flags, held retention and owned cleanup will be reported separately with immutable Git/HF evidence and anonymous readback. Negative/zero-export outcomes remain valid findings; never accept late reward files or substitute orchestration completion for task validity. Keep #53/#33 open for user review; no automatic merge or dataset release. Detailed logs/current accounting in comments.
